idea: Compose the PRLM certificate with confidence-based selection. A step is certified when the quantized margin round(256*z1) - round(256*z2) of the raw logits exceeds 2B with B = 4 (xhw.py, the bound proved for prlm-0). The share of certified steps in a trace is a confidence that is integer-valued, machine-independent wherever the certificate holds, and cheap; no published selection rule uses it. Question: is it a better trace confidence than the published ones (DeepConf token confidence, self-certainty)?

features.cert_share: fraction of a trace's generated tokens whose teacher-forced step is certified (margin > 2B)
features.cert_low: lowest certified share over overlapping windows of 32 tokens (a trace shorter than 32 tokens is one window)
features.computed_by: the same teacher-forced float32 pass as amendment 10 (value_conf.py), on the raw logits before any softmax

space: Amendment 10's space (pools x aggregators, same pools, same enumeration rule), with the two certificate features added as confidences to every confidence aggregator (weighted vote, top-eta filters, Borda). Amendment 10's pre-registered selection and its claims S1-S4 are reported unchanged and separately.
selection: As amendment 10: highest pooled DEV accuracy within the compute class, ties to fewer mean tokens, then to the enumeration order.

claims.A1_primary: the 8-generation rule selected in the extended space is a McNemar WIN over the per-row best floor rule (amendment 10's F0-F6) on the pooled TEST problems, and a LOSS on no row
claims.A2: the best certificate-only rule on DEV (aggregators using cert_share or cert_low, 8-generation class) is a McNemar WIN on the pooled TEST problems over the best published-confidence rule on DEV (aggregators using DeepConf or self-certainty confidences, 8-generation class): the certificate is the better confidence
claims.A3_cost: the certificate features need no top-k or full-vocabulary log-softmax; reported, not claimed

controls.do_nothing: majority vote of the same pool (F0 for CoT-8) is in the space and reported on every row
controls.gamed: a rule picked on TEST is reported beside the DEV-selected rule as the optimistic ceiling of the space, and is never the claim

outcomes: A1 or A2 false is reported as NOT SUPPORTED; a LOSS as REFUTED.
